issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Farm to use a List implemented with an ArrayList for the animals collection and to initialize an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor. The solution implementation uses a Set<Animal> and initializes a HashSet, which conflicts with the specified collection type in the exercise. This discrepancy can confuse students (they are instructed to use ArrayList) and causes the reference solution to diverge from the required design.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by changing the Farm's animals field to a List<Animal> and initializing it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor. Update the getter and setter signatures accordingly. Alternatively, if Set semantics were intended, update the problem statement and UML to specify Set/HashSet instead of List/ArrayList so all artifacts match.
